projectDescription: An AI-assisted triage platform that converts unstructured workplace hazard reports into prioritized, classified proposals for human review.
keyFeatures: AI-assisted triage of workplace hazard notices using Ollama (local) and Gemini (external) providers
Strict human review workflow: every AI proposal must be approved, modified, or rejected by a technician
Risk matrix lookup tool (consultar_matriz_riesgos) with nine closed hazard categories
RAG-based evidence retrieval from a versioned local prevention corpus
Side-by-side provider comparison with concurrent execution and stable ordering
Versioned optimistic-concurrency review with 409 conflict detection
Full audit timeline per notice: triage creation, state transitions, reviewer identity, and corrections
Paginated, filterable notices inbox with search by status, urgency, category, and provider
Reproducible benchmark across 14 labelled cases measuring accuracy, latency, and cost
Aggregated metrics summary: acceptance rate, correction rate, human agreement, token usage, and API cost
React/TypeScript SPA served from FastAPI in Docker; Streamlit dashboard kept as academic fallback
GitHub Actions CI for both backend (pytest) and frontend (vitest + build) without real provider credentials
